name: M.A.R.'s Engineering Company
old_description: M.A.R.'s Engineering is a precision machining company offering screw machining and CNC services. Since 1964 has produced high-accuracy turned components for aerospace, medical and electronic industries.
about:
M.A.R.'s Engineering Company has operated from San Leandro, California since 1964. The family-owned business began as a precision screw machining shop and has remained under family stewardship for nearly six decades.

The company specializes in high-accuracy turned components, running 35 Brown & Sharpe single-spindle screw machines capable of up to five simultaneous operations. Its capabilities extend to multi-spindle screw machining, centerless grinding, CNC milling and water jetting, CNC turning, wire EDM, and in-house finishing — including plating (hard chrome, zinc, black oxide, nickel, gold, Teflon), polishing, and light assembly. A workforce of 50–99 employees handles prototype through production volumes in a single facility.

M.A.R.'s serves aerospace, medical, electronics, automotive, chip manufacturing, food processing, heating and cooling, transportation, electrical/utilities, and music industries. Customers range from OEMs requiring complex prototypes to those needing large production runs of precision parts.

The company emphasizes a quality system built on dual order review, first-article inspection of five to eight pieces per setup, and a three-stage in-process monitoring method where operators batch parts for dimensional verification. Inspectors walk the line twice daily to confirm conformance. This structure, combined with family ownership, is cited as the basis for responsive service and competitive pricing.

name: MANAR | Tennplasco | Plastic Injection Molder & Contract Manufacturer
old_description: We are deeply committed to manufacturing in the USA, supporting American jobs and contributing to the domestic economy. As a 100% employee-owned company since 2016, we build on the rich legacy of founder Gene Nolen, a pioneer in plastic injection molding, empowering our team to invest in customer success.
about:
Manar, Inc. (also operating as Tennplasco) is headquartered in Lafayette, Tennessee. Founded in 1974 by Gene Nolen, a pioneer in plastic injection molding, the company has operated for over 45 years. In 2016, it transitioned to 100% employee ownership, empowering its workforce of approximately 330 employee-owners to invest directly in customer success.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding, offering thermoplastic injection molding, gas-assist molding, and scientific molding across horizontal and vertical presses ranging from 55 to 2,300 tons. It operates multiple facilities: one plant certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 with a white room for medical molding, a second plant certified to ISO 13485 and IATF 16949, and two additional plants certified to IATF 16949. Capabilities extend to in-house tool design, seamless tool transfers, prototyping via additive manufacturing/3D printing, automated assembly, and value-added services such as painting, kitting, and packaging. Process validation (IQ, OQ, PQ) supports early-stage projects.

Manar serves a diverse industrial base including medical device, lawn and garden, consumer products, powersports, automotive and transportation, industrial, aerospace, and power and energy sectors. Its customer roster includes long-standing OEMs; the company notes its very first customer remains a client today.

Founded on Gene Nolen's vision to advance plastic injection molding, Manar emphasizes domestic manufacturing, maintaining all production in the USA. The employee-ownership model, adopted in 2016, aligns the team's incentives with customer outcomes, fostering a culture of accountability and long-term partnership.

name: MBS Fabrications
old_description: MBS fabrication is a woman owned company founded in 1997.  We are specialists in close tolerance sheet metal fabrication, forming, and machining. Our staff bring a strong combination of skills and experience in these and other areas to produce precise and well constructed pieces efficiently.
about:
MBS Fabrication, Inc. operates from Southbridge, Massachusetts, where it was founded in 1997 as a woman-owned business. The company began with a focus on precision sheet metal work and has grown into a specialist in close-tolerance fabrication, forming, and machining.

The shop combines CNC machining, welding, and sheet metal fabrication to produce precision components and sub-assemblies such as cap and baffle assemblies, tube and housing sub-assemblies, dynamic plate sub-assemblies, and effusion plate sub-assemblies. Its quality assurance personnel inspect every part to verify conformance to customer requirements, drawing on a team whose combined experience exceeds 100 years.

While the company serves customers large and small, its certifications — ISO 9001:2015, AS9100:2016, and NADCAP for nonconventional machining and welding — indicate a strong orientation toward aerospace and defense supply chains. The product portfolio reflects the complex, high-reliability assemblies typical of those sectors.

MBS states its mission is to create products held to the highest standards, meet or exceed customer expectations, continuously improve, and deliver jobs on time, every time. This commitment to craftsmanship and timeliness has been the foundation of its reputation for over 25 years.

about:
MECA Electronics, Inc. was founded in 1961 in Denville, New Jersey. The privately held corporation operates under the name Microwave Equipment & Components of America and has manufactured RF and microwave components in the United States for over six decades.

The company designs and produces a broad line of passive RF and microwave components, including fixed attenuators, directional couplers, hybrid couplers, isolators, circulators, power dividers and combiners, RF loads, DC blocks, bias tees, cables, and adapters. Its portfolio extends to integrated assemblies and a high-reliability ML series qualified to military specifications such as MIL-DTL-23971, MIL-DTL-15370, MIL-DTL-39030E, and MIL-STD-202. Products cover frequencies up to 50 GHz and are built by J-STD certified assemblers with standard and enhanced screening options.

MECA serves public safety, rail and transportation, commercial wireless (including distributed antenna systems), 5G/6G and VSAT/SATCOM millimeter-wave markets, as well as aerospace, defense, and space programs. Rail products meet EN50155 environmental standards, while low-PIM components address commercial wireless infrastructure with no power derating to 85 °C. The company also provides value-added kitting and integration of customer-supplied parts.

MECA emphasizes rugged, U.S.-made construction backed by a 36-month warranty. Its differentiators include IP67/68-rated enclosures, thermal and electrical screening processes, and a focus on traceability for ground, air, and space communications where qualification requirements are stringent.

name: MOS Plastics Inc
old_description: Your solution partner for innovative product development and manufacturer of Medical, Diagnostic, and Pharmaceutical products.  Currier MOS Plastics is ISO 13485 certified and FDA registered regional contract manufacturer offering facilities in Central NY and Southern California.
about:
Currier MOS Plastics operates from San Jose, California, with additional facilities in Central New York and Southern California. The company traces its roots to 1982, when Currier Plastics began pursuing a vision of raising service and quality standards in the molding industry. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in public sources.

The company provides turnkey injection molding and blow molding services for Class II and Class III medical devices, running horizontal and vertical injection molding machines inside ISO Class 7 and ISO Class 8 cleanrooms. Capabilities extend to insert molding, two-shot molding, over-molding, and a range of secondary operations including ultrasonic welding, pad and plate printing, cleanroom assembly, kitting, and component preparation. The firm emphasizes end-to-end support from design-for-manufacturing engineering through full-dimensional layout inspection and statistical process control.

Currier MOS Plastics serves medical device, pharmaceutical, drug delivery, diagnostics, life science, and consumer health markets, along with personal care, packaging, consumer products, telecommunications, electronics, and food and beverage sectors. Named customers include Abbott, Agilent, Allergan, and Cepheid, for whom the company produces fluidic components, diagnostic test kits, surgical instruments, implants, syringes, catheters, and electronic device housings.

The company cites its V² philosophy — value multiplied by velocity — as a guiding principle, supported by a continuous improvement program organized into six pillar teams. A sustainability initiative called the 6 Green Program Directions governs material sourcing and waste reduction across its environmentally focused injection and blow molding operations.

name: MP Components Inc
old_description: Located in Michigan and Tennessee, MP Components has grown since 1973 from a model and pattern shop into a solid business that is capable of producing Fixtures and Gauges, Models and Patterns, Molds, Match Metal Dies and Special Machines, along with providing Computer Aided Design (CAD) services. Serving a variety of industries, MP Components strives to deliver superior designed, engineered products to its customers giving them a competitive edge.
about:
MP Components Inc. traces its roots to the fall of 1973, when Otto Schlatter and Larry Wiersma founded Model Pattern Company Inc. in Byron Center, Michigan. The shop began as a model and pattern operation, handcrafting prototypes for local manufacturers. In January 1996, the company was renamed MP Components to reflect its expanding capabilities. Today, the business remains family-owned, with the founders' sons, Joe and John Schlatter, the second generation from facilities in Byron Center, Michigan, and Cookeville, Tennessee.

The company designs and builds a range of tooling, including checking fixtures (from simple to complex automated units), models and foundry patterns, aluminum vacuum molds, blow molds, foam and compression molds, match-metal trim dies, and special machinery. It also provides computer-aided design (CAD) services, CMM inspection, and CNC machining. Operations span a 28,000-square-foot plant in Michigan and a 10,000-square-foot facility in Tennessee, equipped with current-generation machining and measurement technology.

MP Components serves manufacturers in the automotive, furniture, appliance, aerospace, and medical industries. Its customer base extends across the continental United States, Canada, and Mexico, with the two Midwestern locations positioned for broad geographic coverage.

The founders' original mission — to deliver handcrafted quality models and prototypes — continues to shape the company's approach. MP Components emphasizes a one-stop-shop model for tooling needs, backed by ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 17025 certifications, and highlights rapid turnaround times as a key differentiator.

name: Masimo Semiconductor
old_description: Masimo Semiconductor has been developing and manufacturing III-V opto-electronic devices since 1982. Masimo Semiconductor’s scientists and engineers cumulatively have over 100 years of experience and account for over 140 publications, 34 patents, and 3 world record discrete semiconductor devices.
about:
Masimo Semiconductor was founded in 1982 in Hudson, New Hampshire, and has since focused on the development and manufacture of III‑V opto‑electronic devices. The privately held company operates from a facility in Hudson.

The company specializes in wafer epitaxy, foundry services, and device fabrication. Its core processes include GaAs and InP MOCVD epitaxy, custom III‑V epitaxial growth, device fabrication, optical coating evaporation, and device testing. Masimo Semiconductor offers prototype through high‑volume production runs, supported by an on‑site Agnitron A300 MOCVD reactor installed in 2023 and advanced metrology equipment for epitaxial film and device characterization.

Masimo Semiconductor serves the healthcare, industrial, energy, datacom/telecom, security, and consumer products markets. Its components are used in high‑brightness LEDs for medical and commercial applications, as well as in optoelectronics, biomedical devices, and telecommunications systems.

The company positions itself as a cost‑effective product development and manufacturing partner that does not compete with its customers. It emphasizes close collaboration, protection of customer intellectual property, fast turnaround from prototype to volume, and a staff of epitaxy professionals with over 35 years of industry experience. Quality management conforms to ISO 9001:2015.

name: Matrix Plastic Products
old_description: Matrix Plastic Products is a premier custom manufacturer specializing in injection molding, moldmaking & assembly with surgical precision.  We partner with medical device manufacturers to engineer, tool up, and produce ultra-precise molded components and sub-assemblies for their most critical applications.
about:
Matrix Plastic Products operates from Wood Dale, Illinois, just outside Chicago. The company traces its roots to 1978 when it began as Matrix Tooling with seven employees and a family tradition of moldmaking craftsmanship. By 1994 the business had expanded into injection molding, and by 2000 it was running volume production in a facility that had doubled in size.

Today Matrix provides injection molding, moldmaking, and assembly with a focus on surgical precision. Its capabilities include scientific and decoupled molding processes, multi-shot molding, and micro molding for miniature components. The shop runs three shifts on presses ranging from 20 to 300 tons, employs 140 people, and is expanding from its current Wood Dale location to an 88,000-square-foot facility in nearby Bloomingdale. An ISO Class 8 cleanroom supports medical-grade molding and assembly.

The company serves global leaders in the medical device, electronics, personal care, and safety industries. Typical projects include minimally invasive surgical instruments, micro medical devices, and high-performance electronic components. Customers rely on Matrix for full traceability and device-history records that meet regulatory requirements.

Matrix differentiates itself through nearly five decades of in-house design-for-manufacturability and moldmaking expertise, a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016, and a culture that blends traditional craftsmanship with continuous investment in automation and inspection technology. The firm emphasizes reliability, responsiveness, and direct communication between project teams and customers.

name: McCann Fabrication
old_description: McCann Fabrication is a full-service custom metal fabricator that provides a comprehensive range of quality crafted metal products and equipment. Since 1983, we’ve sustained a continuum of growth based on the practice of total quality management and one guiding principal: putting our integrity into action. We use only raw materials of the finest quality, and test all our products to ensure optimal safety and performance. Our impressive range of capabilities includes cutting, bending, welding, machining, waterjet cutting, and finishing, as well as handling and logistics.
about:
McCann Fabrication operates from New Gloucester, Maine, where brothers Bill and Dick McCann founded the company in 1983.

The shop delivers full-service custom metal fabrication across a 26,400-square-foot facility staffed by 30-plus employees running three shifts, seven days a week. Core processes include cutting, bending, welding, machining, 5-axis waterjet cutting, shearing, forming, plasma cutting, plate rolling, punching, band sawing, and finishing, supported by handling and logistics. Key equipment includes Cincinnati hydraulic press brakes (350- and 175-ton), a PaR 5-axis waterjet system with a 73-by-121-inch work envelope, Cincinnati shears, a Vicon CNC plasma cutter, a JetLine seam welder, Hyd-Mech band saws, a Roundo plate roll, and a Geka ironworker.

McCann serves customers in commercial construction, food processing, manufacturing, ornamental metalwork, pharmaceutical, power generation, public works, pulp and paper, and wastewater treatment, among other sectors.

The company emphasizes personalized service enabled by its family ownership, collaborative partnerships with engineering firms and coating houses, and a continuous investment in technology such as 3D CAD (Inventor 2020) and annual equipment upgrades to meet demanding deadlines.

name: Mega Electronics
old_description: MEGA Electronics Inc. was founded in 1994 to provide one source for all components that bring power from the wall into your product, for any location, anywhere in the world. MEGA has emerged as the preferred partner for commercial and industrial use Power Supplies and Cords. The currently available products in this category include wall mount, desktop, DIN rail and open frame power supplies. All in Level VI, mandatory as of 2/2016
about:
Mega Electronics Inc. operates from New Brunswick, New Jersey. Founded in 1984, the company began with the goal of supplying a single source for components that deliver power from the wall into electronic products for any global location. No founders are named in public records, and ownership structure has not been disclosed.

The company designs, manufactures, and distributes power cords, power supplies, and DC/DC converters. Its power supply line spans wall-mount, desktop, DIN-rail, and open-frame formats from 5 W to 960 W, carrying UL, CSA, CE, CCC, CB, and other global safety marks. DC/DC converters range from 0.25 W to 200 W in through-hole, surface-mount, and chassis-mount packages. Mega also produces IEC Lock locking connectors, EN60309 industrial plugs, anti-microbial cables, twist-lock extension cords up to 30 A, and card-edge connectors that mate directly to printed circuit boards. An ISO 9001-certified production facility supports these lines, and a U.S. warehouse enables stock shipment worldwide. The firm offers vendor-managed inventory (VMI), just-in-time (JIT), and kanban programs for blanket and stock-and-release orders.

Mega serves commercial and industrial markets including medical equipment, data centers, computer peripherals, food-service machinery, industrial equipment, networking hardware, and vending machines. Its power cords hold approvals for North America, Europe, Asia, Australia, South America, and the Middle East, allowing customers to ship products globally without separate cord qualifications.

The company cites three pillars—high-quality products, excellent customer service, and superior product knowledge—as its foundation. It emphasizes single-stop shopping for power components, worldwide approval expertise, dedicated engineering support from concept through product life cycle, and a stock-based fulfillment model backed by VMI, JIT, and kanban services.
